questions.question: Which town does Micah 5 name as the birthplace of the coming ruler?
How is this coming ruler described in Micah 5?
options: One who would be the very greatest of all of the warriors
One who would gather to himself the great wealth of nations
One who would rule entirely by his own force and by fear
One whose coming forth is from of old, from ancient days
questions.answer: One whose coming forth is from of old, from ancient days

questions.question: Micah 5 says this ruler shall shepherd his flock and be their peace.
But you, O _____ Ephrathah, who are too little to be among the clans of Judah...
From you shall come forth for me one who is to be _____ in Israel.
